name: OVTLYR plan
rules: Trades OVTLYR's plans from the deck you shared, on the OVTLYR plan section of the crypto page, rebuilt from the screener's data each night. OVTLYR's heatmap and buy/sell signals are private, so it uses stand-ins: heatmap = 14-day RSI; buy signal = the 10-day EMA crossing above the 20-day; sell signal = the 10 under the 20; breadth = the share of coins with the 10 above the 20, against its 10-day average. Bitcoin stands in for SPY and coin categories for sectors.

Plan M (coins), at about 10:00 New York time, when all the market checks passed last night: buys coins with a buy signal in the last 5 days, the 10/20/50 uptrend, the price over the 10 EMA, a rising RSI, $10M+ traded a day, a passing category and no order block within 2%. No price range or earnings check (they're for stock options and earnings). No new Plan M trades while Bitcoin's last close is under its 20 EMA, one of the plan's exits.
Plan M size, the deck's formula: 5% of the account at risk over a 2 ATR move, as far as the cash goes. The coin itself, not the deck's 80-delta calls: coins have no options.

Plan M exits, decided on the live price at about 3:30 PM New York time: a price 0.5 ATR under the entry (the stop loss), the 10 EMA under the 20 (the 10/20 bearish cross, also the sell signal here), Bitcoin under its 20 EMA, RSI at the heatmap target (entry RSI under 50: 63; 50-75: +10; 75 and up: +5), a gap and crap (a 5%+ gap up, then a close under that day's low within 3 days), or reaching an untouched order block above the entry. One that only shows at the day's close (midnight UTC) sells at 10:00 the next morning.

Also sells a Plan M coin at once if it falls 2 ATR under the entry (the emergency exit, checked every 30 minutes), and at about 10:00 New York time the morning after its category's breadth turns bearish, or after 120 days.

Plan ETF, with cash left and no Plan M trade to take: there are no 3x crypto funds like TQQQ or SPXL, so it buys Bitcoin or Ether itself on its own signals (half each if both qualify): heatmap under 70, a buy signal, the uptrend, the price in the value zone (the 20 EMA to 2 ATR above it) and no order block 30+ days old within 2%. Sells at about 10:00 the morning after its 10/20 bearish cross, a close more than 3 ATR above its 20 EMA, or reaching a 30+ day old order block.

Your overbought rule, on top of the plan: no Plan M coin with RSI over 70 or CCI over 100 (checked on the live price when it buys), no Plan ETF buy while that coin is, and nothing while the market's breadth or the coin's category's is over the 75 line.
Plan #SICADFU: the stock version parks spare cash in SGOV, a Treasury bill fund; that isn't a coin, so here spare cash simply waits as cash.
After 3 losing trades in one day, no new trades for 7 days (it keeps the ones it has).
fills: Paper trades, no real money. Coins fill at Yahoo's latest 1-minute price, 0.05% worse, and fractions of a coin are allowed. No exchange fee is charged; real exchanges charge about 0.1% to 0.6% a trade.
